name: CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited
summary: CARsgen Therapeutics Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in discovering, developing, and commercializing chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapies for the treatment of hematological malignancies, solid tumors, and autoimmune diseases in China. The company's products include Zevor-cel (CT053) for the treatment of relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. It is also developing autologous CAR-T product candidates, including CT041, which targets Claudin 18.2, is in phase II/III clinical trial for gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer and pancreatic cancer, as well as in phase I clinical trial for gastric or pancreatic cancer; CT011, which is in phase I clinical trial…
